name: Synthetic Large Metropolitan Utility

scenarios.name: Chemical-dosing tampering
scenarios.description: Attacker changes treatment chemical setpoints; boil-water notice, response, liability.

scenarios.name: Control-system disruption (forced manual operation)
scenarios.description: SCADA/PLC outage forces manual operation, overtime, contractors and lost output.

scenarios.name: Ransomware on IT and billing systems
scenarios.description: Billing and customer systems offline; delayed revenue, recovery and forensic costs.

scenarios.name: Sensor and meter data spoofing
scenarios.description: Falsified telemetry or meter data causes misbilling, rework and regulatory reporting errors.

scenarios.name: Vendor-payment diversion (business email compromise)
scenarios.description: Fraudulent change of a vendor's bank details diverts large invoice payments.

scenarios.name: Customer data breach
scenarios.description: Exposure of customer payment and personal data; notification, monitoring, legal costs.

controls.name: Multi-factor authentication on remote access
controls.description: MFA for all vendor and staff remote access to OT and IT.

controls.name: OT/IT network segmentation
controls.description: Separate control networks from business networks; restrict traffic between them.

controls.name: Offline backups with tested restores
controls.description: Immutable/offline backups for billing, finance and SCADA configurations.

controls.name: Vendor bank-detail call-back verification
controls.description: Independent phone verification before any change to vendor payment details.

controls.name: PLC setpoint limits and safety interlocks
controls.description: Hard limits on chemical dosing setpoints that software commands cannot override.

controls.name: 24/7 security monitoring and response
controls.description: Managed detection and response covering IT and OT.

controls.name: Phishing-resistant staff training
controls.description: Recurring training and simulated phishing for finance and operations staff.

controls.name: Cyber insurance (net of deductible)
controls.description: Transfers part of the loss to an insurer; does not prevent attacks.

notes: SYNTHETIC - illustrative assumptions only, not data from any real utility. Large system; more exposure and a more attractive target, but deeper reserves.
